audience: All walks of life: fitness-minded people, soccer moms, teachers, entrepreneurs, entertainment and actors/actresses. Gender and age not specified, so copy is neutral. Source: Sean (secondhand).
hero_lead: You show up for your family, your students, your clients, your crowd. Your health deserves that same energy. Peptide and hormone therapy, done right: a licensed physician, a protocol built for you, delivered to your door. Valentino sent you here for a reason. Your part is one 15-minute consult.

bio_paragraphs: I'm Valentino Chatman, co-owner and headliner of The Bachelors Nashville, the hottest male revue in town. Whether I'm onstage on Broadway or stepping onstage at a bodybuilding competition, my goal is to stay in the best shape of my life year round. I want to look amazing, feel amazing, and have the energy to give the crowd everything I've got.

I've been bodybuilding and competing for over 10 years. The sport has taught me how to push myself in the gym and how to take care of myself once I leave it. I'm grateful to be in a position to share what I've learned and help others feel stronger and more confident in their own skin.
pull: You get one body, so why not make the most of it and live your best life?
